thread:
nina (Sales): Heads up 1: FinTech client asked for a committed capacity plan to support customer chat. They quoted: target 150 QPS sustained, 420 QPS 15m bursts, avg gen ~160 tokens, context up to 3k. p95 generation target <= 375ms. Need an ops plan + pricing for reserved GPUs + autoscale.

omar (Solutions): Thanks. Any preference on model family? 7B vs 13B will change GPU needs a lot.

jia (ML Eng): If they pick our 13B quantized with KV caching and optimized kernel path we see ~120-160 tokens/sec per A100 with continuous batching. For 160 tokens at 150 QPS that's 24k tokens/sec. Accounting for overhead and tail, baseline of 3 A100s could be tight; I'd recommend 4 reserved with headroom.

harry (InfraOps): From infra side: propose two offer tiers: Standard: 4 reserved A100s, autoscale to 8 for bursts; Premium: 6 reserved, autoscale to 10. Autoscale triggers: sustained queue > 20s for 90s or gpu_util > 80% for 2min. Burst window 15m.

nina (Sales): Good split. Omar, how should we present discounts and burst billing?

omar (Solutions): Present per-month committed price for reserved GPUs (annual vs 6mo discounts), + on-demand autoscale billed by minute with a 20% premium. Include estimated monthly cost ranges for both tiers assuming 5% and 12% burst utilization respectively.

olivia (Security): Security Qs: data residency, KMS, audit logs. For Dedicated we can do private control plane, VPC peering, customer-managed KMS and 1yr default audit retention (extendable). Will provide canned answers.

jia (ML Eng): For POC we should run: step 1 warmup single-GPU profiling; step 2 4-GPU soak at 150 QPS for 4 hours; step 3 420 QPS blast for 15m to validate autoscale and fallback. I'll supply locust scripts and a prompt distribution sample.

harry (InfraOps): Example autoscale snippet for SOW to show thresholds and billing implications:

```
autoscale_policy: {
  min_reserved_gpus: 4,
  max_gpus: 10,
  scale_up_if: queue_seconds > 20 for 90s || avg_gpu_util > 80% for 120s,
  scale_down_if: idle_seconds > 300,
  burst_window_minutes: 15
}
```

Note: burst GPUs billed at on-demand + 20% premium; customers notified at 70% of burst cap.

nina (Sales): Ops hours for POC? Need that for quote (eng + infra + security).

jia (ML Eng): Estimate: 18h model setup/tuning, 10h loadtest ops, 6h analysis = 34h. Add 8h on-call during POC.

harry (InfraOps): Infra work ~12h provisioning + 6h network/security setup + 4h during soak = 22h.

olivia (Security): Security/legal coordination 6h including DPA checklist and questionnaire answers.

omar (Solutions): I'll assemble two pricing rows (Standard & Premium) with cost bands and include burst charge language + an explicit fallback clause: after 3 consecutive mins p95 > 500ms, route 25% traffic to latency-optimized model and escalate.

deploy-bot: Staging cluster note: reserving 4 x A100 for POC on 2025-10-08T07:00Z.

nina (Sales): Action items: omar draft pricing + SOW, jia share loadtest scripts, harry attach autoscale template and IP whitelist, olivia attach security snippets. POC target start next Wed.

omar (Solutions): Will deliver SOW + cost worksheet by EOD tomorrow.

jia (ML Eng): I'll push locust scripts & example batch config to the repo and link in this thread.

harry (InfraOps): Sending network + KMS checklist in thread shortly.

nina (Sales): Thanks team :clap: I'll sync with the customer after we have the SOW.
